description: Direct empirical SN-channel kappa fit on the corpus depth coordinate X=S_A sigma^2/c^2, corpus convention dmu=-kappa X (kappa>0: deep wells brighter). Exact GLS with full covariance.

kappa_Cep_transfer_context.note: step_04_08's frozen 3.69e5 is stale: current step_44 gives 7.5e5+/-3.4e5 (joint) and ~1.2e6 (redshift-only prior value); step_50 unified gives 4.4e5+/-4.1e5. The transfer is a benchmark, not a sharp prediction.

calibrator_jackknife.note: leave-one-host-group-out over 22 mass-groups within the 77-SN calibrator block (mass-step marginalized)

joint_kappa_plus_calibrator_offset.note: kappa survives with the calibrator intercept freed; the two effects coexist

calibrator_X_leverage.note: calibrator hosts reach ~6x deeper X than the flow wing; they are the only objects with depth leverage to detect the response

full_fit_with_mass_step.note: kappa survives marginalizing the binary mass step on the full sample (3.3 sigma)

diagonal_covariance_only.note: signal partially relies on correlated covariance structure (shared-host systematics)

robustness.sentinel_masses: 0 of 1701 objects carry the mass sentinel (-9); explicit exclusion reproduces kappa exactly

interpretation: Two independent catalogs return positive kappa in the corpus-predicted direction (deep wells brighter). Pantheon+ signal localizes to the calibrator/low-z anchor sector (kappa=5.6e4+/-2.2e4, 2.6 sigma on 77 Cepheid hosts with the binary mass step marginalized); the flow wing is consistent with zero. DES-Dovekie shows a broad high-mass response (kappa=1.6e5+/-3.3e4 on logM>=10, ~4.8 sigma) with no permutation exceedances in 200 realizations. Amplitudes differ (3-9e4 across catalogs) and are ~10x below the Cepheid-channel kappa_Cep~7e5; response coefficients are channel-specific, so the frozen transfer is excluded but the mechanism's sign and X-localization replicate.
